Input image 1: STYLE reference only, one of the game's approved captain portraits. Match its realistic painterly digital portrait style, head-and-shoulders framing, soft directional light and restrained detail. Do not copy that person, the navy uniform or the bridge.
Input image 2: SHIP AND LIVERY reference, the approved painting of the trader's ship, the Long Odds: white and charcoal hull, lilac-and-white striped market canopy, brass fittings. Use its colors for the clothing and the background; the ship itself does not appear.
Composition/framing: one opaque square portrait, exactly 1024 x 1024 pixels. Head and shoulders plus one raised hand; the face a little above center, turned three-quarters toward the viewer, the eyes about 38% from the top. Keep the face, beard, loupe and raised hand inside the central 80% so the portrait survives a rounded-square crop. It must read at 72 pixels: a strong silhouette and clear light-dark separation between the face and an uncluttered background.
Subject: Teo Brannick, an independent free trader in their sixties: big, broad-shouldered and heavyset; weathered, ruddy skin with deep laugh lines; bushy grey eyebrows; a long grey beard woven into two thick braids bound with small brass rings; a jeweler's brass loupe on a hinged headband flipped down over one eye, magnifying it; heavy brass and silver rings on every finger. A worn cream-and-plum spacer's long coat with brass buttons and frayed cuffs, a lilac-and-white striped scarf, a cargo-tag lanyard. One ringed hand is raised beside the face, holding up a small dark semiconductor module between thumb and forefinger as if naming its price. Expression: a broad, knowing, theatrical grin; a showman about to haggle, charming and a little dangerous, enjoying every second.
Background: the Long Odds' cargo deck, softly out of focus: stacked crates and strapped containers under the lilac-and-white striped canopy, a warm amber hanging lamp, a cool blue-white cargo-screen glow at one edge.
Style/medium: high-end realistic digital painting matching the game's captain portraits; grounded materials (worn wool, brass, leather), believable anatomy and hands. Not a cartoon, not a photograph, not a poster.
Lighting/mood: warm amber key light from the lamp, a cool blue-white rim on the far side, a faint lilac bounce from the canopy; friendly, roguish, larger than life.
Constraints: absolutely no text, letters, numbers, logos, labels, watermark, borders, frames or interface. No weapons. Exactly one person. Deliver exactly one finished portrait.
Production clarifications: Generate a new, original person. The references are only for painting style and palette. Keep the cargo tag and semiconductor module completely blank and unmarked, with no glyphs or pseudo-writing. The raised hand is anatomically correct with five fingers including the thumb; the thumb and forefinger visibly pinch the small dark module. Leave breathing room around both complete beard braids, the raised hand and the loupe inside the central 80% of the square. All facial details remain painted and restrained, with clear readable value masses at thumbnail size. Output a single finished opaque 1024 x 1024 image.
